text:
maria (AE): Hey team — Acme (rhea) sent over their enterprise checklist. Key asks: IdP-initiated SAML, SCIM delta-only sync after an initial CSV import, role→RBAC mapping, delegated tenant admins (3), and DNS-based domain proofing. They also want ballpark cost impact.

sam (SE): We support IdP-init and SP-init SAML. SCIM: delta sync via PATCH/PUT is supported; we also have a bulk import endpoint for initial onboarding. Default SCIM rate limit is 20 req/s/org — can raise for Dedicated. Any constraints around group claims?

rhea (Acme): They'll be sending groups in the assertion (groups claim) and want groups mapped to roles in Redwood. Also they want no full SCIM pulls after initial import.

jordan (Security Eng): Confirming: we can map groups→RBAC roles. We support custom SCIM attributes but mapping may need a tiny adapter if they use non-standard schema. Also need to confirm SAML NameID format (email vs persistent).

sam (SE): Example config for group->role mapping (for our docs):
```
attrs:
  groups: claim: 'groups'
  role_map:
    'engineering': 'engineer'
    'admins': 'admin'
```
This will be in the SE playbook.

maria (AE): Pricing question from procurement: does SCIM/role-sync add incremental fees? Short answer: hosted API pricing isn't per-SCIM operation, but heavy SCIM traffic (large orgs) can require Dedicated/reserved capacity which has a monthly fee. I'll put numbers below.

olivia (CSM): They asked for SOC2 + data residency note. Jordan — can you attach SOC2 link and call out Private/VPC options?

jordan (Security Eng): SOC2 link: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2. Data residency: hosted has EU + US regions; Private supports VPC/on-prem with KMS/HSM options. I'll draft a one-pager for HIPAA/SOC2 bullet points.

rhea (Acme): One blocker: they require domain ownership proof before we can enable force-SSO and auto-provisioning. Is DNS TXT verification OK?

sam (SE): DNS TXT is preferred. We also support verification via a verification email to a domain admin or via CNAME for automated tooling. DNS TXT + a short TTL is fastest.

maria (AE): POC scope: 2-week POC covering SSO + initial CSV import + SCIM delta + sample RBAC rules. Can SE/PS spin up a test tenant? If Dedicated capacity is needed for throughput, provisioning lead time ~72 hours.

sam (SE): I can provision a hosted test org quickly. If we need higher SCIM throughput for the POC, request Dedicated test pool — tagging deploy-bot to queue provisioning. Need IdP metadata and a sample CSV from Acme.

deploy-bot: Build request queued — ticket #REQ-4821. ETA provisioning 72 hours.

maria (AE): AE-side next steps: send checklist + pricing table; SE to validate metadata and run the first sync; Security to provide SOC2 + privacy note; CSM to prepare onboarding checklist. I'll coordinate dates after deploy ETA.

rhea (Acme): Sending IdP metadata + sample CSV in DM now. Also noted they'd like delegated admin accounts to mirror 'owner' role in their IdP.

sam (SE): Received metadata. Will validate SAML assertion format today and follow up on any mapping mismatches.

maria (AE): Ballpark costs to cite in proposal: hosted POC — no additional platform charge; Dedicated test pool (small) — $2,400/month prorated; SCIM high-throughput add-on — $300/month. Final quote after procurement confirms scale.

olivia (CSM): I'll prepare a 1-page runbook for the POC: steps for CSV import, SCIM troubleshooting (delta mismatch, 409s, rate-limit backoffs), and verification checklist for domain proofing.

maria (AE): Great. Tagging thread for follow-up in sales pipeline. :thumbsup:

rhea (Acme): Thanks — appreciate the speedy responses. I'll loop in procurement after I get the draft pricing.

sam (SE): Okay — I'll post the mapping checklist and a short test plan later today.

maria (AE): Closing notes: timeline looks like provisioning in ~72h, metadata validation same day, initial import + SCIM test within first week of POC. I'll update thread when deploy-bot ticket advances.
